summary: Iter24 Admin Invoicing tested end-to-end. Backend: 10 PASS + 1 intentionally skipped (storno fixture already consumed). Frontend: all 4 sub-tabs (Subscriptions / Contact Fees / Storno / Company Settings) render, EUR-DE locale formatting works, PDF opens, Save toast fires, Klein toggle correctly disables VAT-rate dropdown, Storno tab shows mirrored GUT- credit notes with negative EUR amounts. Two MINOR data-testid issues found.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid 'cs-input-is-kleinunternehmer' is on the wrapper <label> instead of the <input type=checkbox> inside it. Playwright programmatic click on the testid (force=True) does NOT trigger the React onChange (state stays unchanged). Real users clicking the visible label area DO toggle the checkbox via the native label→input bubble — so the feature works in practice, but breaks any automated test that targets the testid directly. Recommend moving data-testid onto the <input> element.

data-testid naming inconsistency: spec/agent-context says testids should be 'cs-input-{field}' where field uses underscores (e.g. cs-input-is_kleinunternehmer, cs-input-default_vat_rate). Frontend actually emits the hyphen-cased 'cs-input-is-kleinunternehmer' and 'cs-input-default-vat-rate' while siblings correctly use underscores (cs-input-legal_name, cs-input-postal_code, cs-input-vat_id, etc). Internally inconsistent and diverges from the spec.

action_items: LOW: Move data-testid='cs-input-is-kleinunternehmer' from the <label> onto the <input type=checkbox> child so programmatic test clicks toggle React state.

LOW: Rename 'cs-input-is-kleinunternehmer' → 'cs-input-is_kleinunternehmer' and 'cs-input-default-vat-rate' → 'cs-input-default_vat_rate' to match the underscore convention used by the rest of the cs-input-* family and the agent-context spec.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/admin_invoicing_routes.py: generate-subscriptions silently swallows per-pro exceptions (try/except pass at line 129-130) and same in generate-fees (152-155). Operationally this means a single bad pro_profile won't break the batch, but it also means failures are invisible to the admin. Consider logging the exception or returning failures[] in the response.

/app/backend/routes/admin_invoicing_routes.py: get_invoice / get_invoice_pdf catch a bare Exception when parsing ObjectId — fine but masks real DB errors as 404. Specifically catching InvalidId would be cleaner.

/app/backend/routes/admin_invoicing_routes.py: PUT /company-settings replaces whole doc and returns serialize_doc(payload). After replace_one with upsert, the returned payload contains the in-memory _id='default' string. Ensure serialize_doc doesn't leak this as _id in the response (looks fine via serialize_doc that maps _id→id, but worth double-checking on the singleton key being the literal string 'default').

/app/frontend/src/pages/admin/tabs/AdminInvoicing.jsx: data-testid placement on wrapper <label> (line 545) instead of the <input> child is the only test-stability defect; React state is correctly wired (form.is_kleinunternehmer → disabled prop on VAT select line 565).

/app/frontend/src/pages/admin/tabs/AdminInvoicing.jsx: file is large (~600+ lines with 4 panels). Consider splitting SubscriptionsTab / FeesTab / StornoTab / CompanySettingsTab into separate files for maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on functional behavior; 2 LOW data-testid hygiene findings

seed_data_creation: None. Test suite reused pre-existing pro user data and previously-generated subscription invoice (RG-2026-0001) plus its storno (GUT-2026-0001) from earlier sessions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter24 invoicing endpoints + UI are green. The only subscription invoice (RG-2026-0001 for pro@test.com / Weber Installations) is in 'cancelled' status because of the storno backend test. To exercise the live Storno modal UI flow, a new uncancelled subscription invoice must exist: either upgrade another pro to plan_tier='pro' and run generate-subscriptions, OR drop the 'cancelled' status on RG-2026-0001 in Mongo (db.invoices). Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter24_invoicing.py is the regression suite — run with `pytest backend/tests/test_iter24_invoicing.py -v`. Company settings singleton lives at db.company_settings _id='default'.
rca of the issue: No critical bugs. Two LOW-priority frontend testid hygiene issues: (1) data-testid='cs-input-is-kleinunternehmer' is placed on the wrapper <label> rather than the underlying <input type=checkbox>. Playwright force-clicks on the label do not propagate to the input → React onChange doesn't fire → state unchanged → VAT-rate dropdown stays enabled. Real users clicking the visible label area work fine (native label→input click bubble). Mitigation: move the data-testid attribute onto the <input> element. (2) The two settings testids 'cs-input-is-kleinunternehmer' / 'cs-input-default-vat-rate' use hyphen separators while every other cs-input-* testid in the same component uses underscores (cs-input-legal_name, cs-input-postal_code, cs-input-vat_id, etc.). The agent-context spec also stipulates the underscore form. Mitigation: rename to cs-input-is_kleinunternehmer / cs-input-default_vat_rate for consistency.
